_provenance.description: From-scratch 30-epoch AdaPoinTr baseline on ShapeNet-55, stratified S/M/H eval. Provides a reproducible matched-configuration replay of the Pitfall 2 warm-start comparison; total 7h37min GPU on a single RTX 5090 (cudnn.benchmark=True for throughput).
_provenance.purpose: Reproducible raw artefact for the warm-start inflation comparison referenced in sec3.2 Pitfall 2.
_provenance.eval_protocol: ShapeNet-55 official 8-viewpoint stratified S/M/H eval (n=2048/4096/6144 incomplete points -> 8192 complete)
_provenance.reproducibility_caveat: cudnn.benchmark=True causes minor (<2%) nondeterminism in per-batch loss accumulation over 30 epochs. Epoch 0 batch 1 loss is BIT-EXACT match to original; epoch 10 val CDL2 drifts <0.2%; epoch 30 final CDL2 drifts <1%. S/M/H eval CDL2 (this artefact) drifts up to -3.8% on Hard vs paper original.

training_validation_summary.description: Validation results during training (val_freq=10 triggers at epoch 0, 10, 20, 30). Verified against original Apr 13-14 run.

smh_eval.description: Stratified Simple/Moderate/Hard CD-L2 eval on ckpt-epoch-030.pth. This is the V_fromscratch baseline used as denominator for paper sec3.2 double-digit (+14-21%) warm-start inflation paired delta computation.

paired_delta_vs_diffcond_oracle.description: Paper sec3.2 warm-start inflation gain (+14-21% double-digit per bin). The primary calculation is seed-matched (V_fromscratch_seed42 vs D_diffcond_oracle_seed42). A secondary calculation against the DiffCond 3-seed mean is reported only for cross-reference; it is NOT a true paired test (it mixes a single from-scratch seed with a 3-seed DiffCond mean).
paired_delta_vs_diffcond_oracle.reading_seed_matched: Under seed-matched (seed 42 only) comparison, all three bins yield positive double-digit warm-start inflation: Simple +17.67%, Moderate +18.68%, Hard +14.92%. This reproduces the per-bin double-digit signature reported in the paper. The pilot per-bin estimates (Simple +18.01%, Moderate +20.53%, Hard +17.23%) referenced in sec3.2 derive from an earlier exploratory run whose raw aggregate was not retained in the bundle; the rerun reported here corroborates direction and order of magnitude.

secondary_for_reference_only_not_paired.description: Cross-check using DiffCond 3-seed mean as denominator. Not a paired test (mixes 1 from-scratch seed with 3 DiffCond seeds), included only to document the calculation referenced in earlier drafts.
